evals.prompt: Reply to https://x.com/example/status/1234567890123456789 with exactly: Thanks for sharing — this is useful.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the exact target/text pair, runs full preflight and dry-run, displays both, and stops for explicit approval before one dispatch.
expectations: Does not change the target or reply punctuation
Uses tw action reply with --dry-run before approval
Does not claim a reply was sent during dry-run

evals.prompt: 回复这条 https://x.com/example/status/1234567890123456789，原文：这个角度很有启发，谢谢分享。
evals.expected_output: Uses Simplified Chinese interface text, preserves target and reply exactly, and waits for explicit approval.
expectations: Keeps commands and schema identifiers in English

evals.prompt: Reply 'nice work' to that tweet we looked at earlier.
evals.expected_output: Asks for the exact status URL/ID/ref and does not infer the target from history or browser state.
expectations: Does not run dry-run or mutation against an inferred target
Asks only for the missing target

evals.prompt: Approved, but use the other link and add an exclamation mark.
evals.expected_output: Invalidates prior approval, asks for an exact replacement target if absent, dry-runs the changed pair, and requests approval again.
expectations: Does not reuse approval after target or text changes
Never retries an unknown reply result
